common.offline: No connection. History and favorites work offline.

translate.title: Translate
translate.subtitle: Type text — the translation appears automatically. For 1–3 words a full dictionary entry appears below.
translate.emptyText: Type a word or a phrase on the left. The translation will appear here in a moment.
translate.voiceDenied: The microphone could not be turned on. Allow access in your browser settings.
translate.voiceUnsupported: This browser does not support voice input.

word.needAi: The full word entry needs AI, and today's free requests are used up. The translation above is ready.

check.title: German check
check.subtitle: Corrections with an explanation for every mistake

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: Word cards, favorites and history stay on your device.
dictionary.favoritesEmpty: No favorites yet. Tap the star next to a translation.
dictionary.historyEmpty: Your history is empty. Translate something on the Translate tab.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: App settings and AI access
profile.keysHint: The shared site keys have a daily limit. Your own free key removes it and stays only on this device.
profile.privacy: Your keys stay yours: the server only uses them for a request. In your account the key is stored encrypted.
profile.limitsTextFree: Without signing in or adding your own key the shared keys have a daily limit. An account and your own free key remove the limit.
profile.privacyAccount: In your account the key is encrypted and never shown in full — only the last 4 characters.
profile.installText: Open the site in your phone browser and add it to the home screen — the translator then works like a regular app.
profile.installIos: On iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android: menu ⋮ → Install app.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Sign in and your AI keys, favorites and history will be the same on all your phones and computers.
account.sharedHint: One login works on several phones — you can even share it with your family.
account.registerHint: Login: 3–32 characters, Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore. Password: at least 8 characters.
account.newPasswordHint: After the change other devices are signed out. This phone stays signed in.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

errors.invalidCredentials: Wrong login or password. Please check and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes.
errors.loginTaken: This login is already taken. Choose another one or sign in with it.
errors.loginInvalid: Login: 3–32 characters, Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again — favorites, history and keys are safe.
errors.keysStorageDisabled: Storing keys in the account is turned off right now. The key can be saved on this device.
errors.keyNoAccess: This key does not grant access. Make sure you copied all of it.

keys.geminiStep1: Sign in with Google — any Google account works.
keys.geminiStep2: Click “Create API key” and copy the key.
keys.geminiStep3: Come back here: the field fills itself and the key is checked.
keys.groqStep1: Sign up or sign in to the Groq Console.
keys.groqStep2: Click “Create API Key” and copy the key.
keys.groqStep3: Come back here: the field fills itself and the key is checked.
keys.checkOk: The key works, answer in {{ms}} ms
keys.checkFailed: The key did not work. Make sure you copied all of it.
keys.accountHint: Sign in to “Account” above so the key works on all your devices.
keys.introAccount: Your own free key removes the daily limit. When you are signed in it is stored in your account and works on all your devices.
keys.introDevice: Your own free key removes the daily limit. Until you sign in, the key stays only on this device.
keys.privacyAccount: The key is encrypted on the server and never shown in full — only the last 4 characters.
keys.privacyDevice: The key stays in this browser and goes to the server only in the request header.

services.title: Site services
services.intro: Which services are connected. The button below sends each one a small real request, so you can see whether it answers.
services.cached: The result is fresh: the check runs at most every 10 minutes.

limit.title: Connect your free key
limit.text: The free requests for today are used up. Your own key is free and needs no card.
limit.geminiStep3: Copy the key and paste it below
limit.groqStep3: Copy the key and paste it below
limit.keyFail: The key did not work. Make sure you copied all of it.
limit.privacyNote: The key stays only on your device.

soon.learnText: Flashcards, exercises and streaks are the next stage. Meanwhile, try the dictionary.
soon.conversationText: The two-person conversation mode comes later. Practise translation and listening for now.

errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.limit: The free requests are used up. Connect your own key — it is free.
errors.validation: Please check your input and try again.
errors.tooLong: The text is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.badJson: The service answered unexpectedly. Please try again.
errors.server: Server error. Please try again later.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Wait a few seconds.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.sameLanguage: The source and target languages are the same.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again — your data is safe.

compare.subtitle: The same text in every connected service
